notes.title: Demo version update announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo version of P4ST3L! I'm Usagi, the developer.

This build: Build:D_TGD8

The following will be updated.

-Improved so that when entering numbers on the keyboard in the PIN input panel,

number buttons can be entered with the mouse.

-When a rootable bag or backpack is empty, the HUD will display that there is nothing inside.

-Implemented experimental support for XBOX controllers.

Basic operations can be completed with the controller, but mouse operations are required in the inventory and menus, so in the future we plan to improve it to partial controller support.

Assignments are fixed, but we will work hard to make them remappable.

-Adjusted bleeding probability
-Reduced the probability of bleeding from enemy attacks, falls, and ammo generators. (Probability is not disclosed.)

The contents of the previous update are here.

-Support for Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese (Chinese).
-You can change the language setting from the main menu's language setting drop-down list. Some texts are not translated yet.

- The level of Chapter 1 has been temporarily shortened. You can try out a short demo with an estimated play time of about 30 minutes. The original size may be restored without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

- The maximum number of items that can be held in the inventory has been increased to 6.

- The rate at which hunger and thirst levels decrease has been reduced. In the future, we plan to make it possible to change the rate at which they decrease depending on the difficulty setting. Since this is a demo version, hunger and thirst levels do not decrease very much, so I think the impact of the stamina penalty is small.

- The item spawn rate for shelves and lockers that can be looted has been corrected. It is now easier to obtain items.

We are considering changing this item spawn rate depending on the difficulty setting.

- If an enemy has detected you with their eyes, a warning will be displayed at the top of the HUD.

- Other minor fixes

- We are currently developing new game stages and enemies. We have passed the early access review and are preparing for the release of the early access version.

If you notice any issues or bugs, please report them on the message board.

Please update the game from your Steam library. If you are unable to update, please uninstall the game and reinstall it.

notes.title: General update announcements
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo version of P4ST3L! I'm UsaginO, the developer.

This build: D_2025022301

The following will be updated.

- The continue button has been removed from the main menu and replaced with a chapter button
- Added levels to the chapter menu
- Added a prequel chapter. This chapter can be selected by returning to the chapter menu after clearing chapter 1. A game save function has been added from now on. The game is saved at the end of each chapter and whether it has been cleared or not is determined.
- Chapter 2 is being developed for early access, but there are currently no plans to allow chapters 2 and beyond to be played in the demo version.
- About the retry function when the game is over
In this build, you can restart with HP restored to 50 by pressing E on the keyboard while the game over widget is displayed. This restart will return you to the starting point, but your access level, lootable shelves, lockers, backpacks, and enemy life/death status will remain the same. If you press the space bar when the game is over, you can restart with all progress reset. We are considering adding revival items and life items in the future, and changing the difficulty level to allow or not allow revival. This restart by pressing the E key will be discontinued or changed without notice. It will occur when you have a specific item, and will occur on low difficulty levels.

・Other minor fixes
・We are currently developing new game stages and enemies. We have passed the early access review, so we are preparing for the release of the early access version.

If you notice any problems or bugs, please report them on the bulletin board.

Please update the game from your Steam library. If you cannot update, please uninstall the game and reinstall it.

notes.title: Bug fix announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo version of P4ST3L! I'm UsaginO, the developer.

I participated in an offline event called Tokyo Game Dungeon 7 in 2025.

I'd like to inform you of the update on bugs and improvements that occurred during the event.

This build: D_TGD702

The following will be updated.

Bug fixes

- Fixed a bug in the first room where the camera would switch to the level sequence and not return to Nato's camera by repeatedly pressing the level sequence in the event where you search for the door key.

- Fixed a bug where you could not return if you opened the inventory or pause menu while displaying widgets such as the PIN, slide, and scattered logs.

- Fixed a bug where enemies would not spawn when the first enemy encounter event occurred.

Improvements

- Mouse sensitivity when aiming can now be changed. Mouse sensitivity while aiming also changes depending on the sensitivity set in the camera sensitivity (mouse sensitivity) in the pause menu.

- Improved visibility of some logs and PIN panels.
・Fixed the problem of enemy attacks penetrating the exit gate of the yellow slide (VIP room) by changing the mesh.

・The inventory menu and pause menu can no longer be opened while using consumable items. This has made it impossible to use items immediately and continuously.

・Other minor fixes

・We are currently developing new game stages and enemies. We have passed the early access review and are preparing for the release of the early access version.

Please report any issues or bugs you notice.

Please update the game from your Steam library. If you are unable to update, please uninstall the game and reinstall it.
